
## Computing correlation between 

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

clip_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/clip_probs.csv')
spose_49_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/spose_49_probs.csv')
spose_66_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/spose_66_probs.csv')
srf_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/srf_probs.csv')
agg_5plus = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/agg_5plus.csv')
human_probs = agg_5plus[['id_a', 'id_b', 'id_c', 'prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']]
vlm_df = pd.read_csv('vlm/runs/study-2000/results.csv')
vlm_probs = vlm_df[['id_a', 'id_b', 'id_c', 'prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']].copy()
```

```{python}
dfs = {
    "human": human_probs,
    "clip": clip_probs,
    "spose49": spose_49_probs,
    "spose66": spose_66_probs,
    "srf": srf_probs,
    "vlm" : vlm_probs
}

# TEMP - testing with vlm pilot output (10 trials)
# dfs = {k: v.head(10) for k, v in dfs.items()}
# print("Only using the first 10 trials for each modality to test VLM results")

cols = ["prob_a", "prob_b", "prob_c"]

# Flatten each DataFrame into one vector
vectors = {
    name: df[cols].to_numpy().flatten()
    for name, df in dfs.items()
}

# Compute pairwise correlations
corr_matrix = pd.DataFrame({
    name1: {
        name2: np.corrcoef(v1, v2)[0, 1]
        for name2, v2 in vectors.items()
    }
    for name1, v1 in vectors.items()
})

print(corr_matrix.round(3))
```

```{python}
sns.heatmap(
    corr_matrix,
    annot=True,
    fmt=".3f",
    cmap="coolwarm",
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    square=True
)

plt.title("Correlation Between Probability Distributions")
plt.show()
```

## NEXT PLOT
```{python}
# for each modality: (i.e spose49)
    # compute the diff against human

def compute_diff(model, human):
    """
    model and human must each have columns ['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']
    """
    df_out = pd.DataFrame(
        columns=['model_prob_a', 'model_prob_b', 'model_prob_c', 'human_prob_a', 'human_prob_b', 'human_prob_c', 'diff_a', 'diff_b', 'diff_c', 'diff_sum'])
    df_out[['model_prob_a', 'model_prob_b', 'model_prob_c']] = model[['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']]
    df_out[['human_prob_a', 'human_prob_b', 'human_prob_c']] = human[['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']]
    df_out['diff_a'] = abs(df_out['model_prob_a'] - df_out['human_prob_a'])
    df_out['diff_b'] = abs(df_out['model_prob_b'] - df_out['human_prob_b'])
    df_out['diff_c'] = abs(df_out['model_prob_c'] - df_out['human_prob_c'])
    df_out['diff_sum'] = df_out['diff_a'] + df_out['diff_b'] + df_out['diff_c']
    df_out['diff_mean'] = df_out['diff_sum']/3
    df_out['diff_sd'] = df_out[['diff_a', 'diff_b', 'diff_c']].std(axis=1)
    return df_out
```

```{python}
spose_49_diff = compute_diff(spose_49_probs, human_probs)
spose_66_diff = compute_diff(spose_66_probs, human_probs)
srf_diff = compute_diff(srf_probs, human_probs)
clip_diff = compute_diff(clip_probs, human_probs)
```

## Plotting
```{python}
def plot_mean_difference(model_diff, human_probs, model_name="(model)"):

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    ax.scatter(
        human_probs[['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']].max(axis=1),
        model_diff['diff_sum'], 
        alpha=0.5
    )
    plt.title(f'{model_name} mean difference from human probabilities.')
    plt.xlabel('Maximum choice probability (human)')
    plt.ylabel('Mean absolute difference from human probabilities')
    ax.axvline(x=0.333, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='x min (x=0.333)')

    plt.show()
```

```{python}
plot_mean_difference(spose_49_diff, human_probs, "SPoSE-49")
plot_mean_difference(spose_66_diff, human_probs, "SPoSE-66")
plot_mean_difference(srf_diff, human_probs, "SRF")
plot_mean_difference(clip_diff, human_probs, "CLIP")
```

```{python}
def plot_max_probabilities(model_probs, human_probs, model_name="(model)"):

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    ax.scatter(
        human_probs[['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']].max(axis=1),
        model_probs[['prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']].max(axis=1),
        alpha=0.25
    )
    plt.title(f'Max estimated prob. for {model_name} and human choices.')
    plt.xlabel('Maximum choice probability (human)')
    plt.ylabel('Maximum choice probability (model)')
    ax.axvline(x=0.333, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='x min (x=0.333)')
    ax.axhline(y=0.333, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='y min (y=0.333)')
    plt.xlim((0.3, 1))
    plt.ylim((0.3, 1))
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
plot_max_probabilities(spose_49_probs, human_probs, "SPoSE-49")
plot_max_probabilities(spose_66_probs, human_probs, "SPoSE-66")
plot_max_probabilities(srf_probs, human_probs, "SRF")
plot_max_probabilities(clip_probs, human_probs, "CLIP")
```
